text: The simple roots of a root system are precisely those positive roots that CAN be written as a sum of two other positive roots.
explanation: False: the simple roots $\Delta$ are exactly the positive roots that canNOT be decomposed as a sum of other positive roots. They form the minimal generating set with $|\Delta| = \dim V = \text{rank}$, and every positive root is a non-negative integer combination of them; the statement inverts the definition.
